# Ordinary-only HC RMS owner candidate

The private provider derives independently from official Gufo pin
f783fedb9bea2ec7de941f6da4e02f4a4596b29e and the retained measured
ssm-fixed-bounds parent. No sibling CachyOS/DS4 project code is imported.
Gufo's MIT notices remain; first-party fixtures/tools/dispatch edits are MIT.

The ordinary owner kernel is extracted byte-for-byte from the existing private
Gufo-derived RMS owner include. The complete component qualifies120 exact
output records on .157. The extraction adds one include and changes only the
existing F32/half wrapper's n>=96 selection. All162 original numerical bodies
and resources remain identical; the added body matches the qualified fixture.
The MoE owner body is omitted, and original MoE/small-row/decode dispatch remains.

There is no new persistent allocation, stream, callback or executor lifetime
change. Public C17 ABI/state/metrics contracts are unchanged. No CPU model forward is introduced. The subsequent one-model retry preserves
all21 parent output files exactly, but its prefill median changes−0.067176%
with overlapping ranges. Keep the earlier performance best; independent quality,
production adoption and full-curve parity remain open. The source/static
preparation records retain their original state and identities.
